 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The march to a high school football championship in the 2026 IHSA playoffs continued with first-round action on Friday, Oct. 30.
 Peoria-area contenders Pekin, Morton, Washington, LaSalle-Peru, Farmington, El Paso-Gridley, Annawan-Wethersfield and Peru-St. Bede are all on the field Friday night, with more area teams getting their chances on Saturday.

 88-84? A state record has fallen
 Imagine scoring 84 points in a football playoff game. At home.
 And losing.
 That's exactly what just happened Friday in an afternoon Class 6A first-round playoff game that produced an IHSA state record for most points in a game where both teams score.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement No. 9 seed Quincy Sr rolled into town and beat No. 8 Chicago Goode, 88-84.
 The record they broke was close to home for Peoria-area football. It was an 82-80 overtime game in which Peoria High beat Peoria Notre Dame on Sept. 15, 2017 at Peoria Stadium.
 You can relive that one via our Journal Star story on the game right here .
